name: Nintendo Game Boy Advance
significance: Maintained the commercial vitality of elite 2D sprite artistry during the industry's wholesale transition to 3D polygons.

verifiedFactualData.ram: 32 KB internal RAM, 256 KB external RAM, 96 KB VRAM

editorialContent.overview: A 32-bit pocket Super Nintendo that extended the Golden Age of 2D pixel art well into the 21st century.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: Maintained the commercial vitality of elite 2D sprite artistry during the industry's wholesale transition to 3D polygons.
editorialContent.controllerDesign: Horizontal form-factor with D-pad, A, B, L, and R shoulder buttons
